LanguageData.DMSAC_FoamSpray.label: 消防泡沫
LanguageData.DMSAC_FoamSpray.description: 从保养槽喷出一股消防泡沫，压熄火焰并在地面铺上泡沫。
LanguageData.DMSAC_Ability_SmokeSalvo.label: 烟幕齐射

LanguageData.DMSAC_Ability_MGPod.label: 机枪荚舱
